title: Getting past the screen of death.

posts.author: Game_Development
posts.body:
My friend sent me his old RPG Maker XP game. Decades old. Now I did ask him if there was some code or secret but of course he didn't remember. I've checked the code of the game, but I don't have the knowhow to figure out what's wrong.
I boot up the game, get the u popup, then get the knight screen. It's maybe a title screen processing error? Possibly?
Here's the Scene_Title script
Spoiler
Spoiler:
code
** Scene_Title
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs title screen processing.
#==============================================================================

battle_test

end

@command_window.y = 288
# Continue enabled determinant

@continue_enabled = true
end
end

# If disabled, display "Continue" text in gray

@command_window.index = 1
else
@command_window.disable_item(1)
end
# Play title BGM
$game_system.bgm_play($data_system.title_bgm)
# Stop playing ME and BGS
Audio.me_stop
Audio.bgs_stop
# Execute transition
Graphics.transition()
# Main loop
loop do
# Update game screen
Graphics.update
# Update input information
Input.update
# Frame update
update
# Abort loop if screen is changed
if $scene != self
break
end
end
# Prepare for transition

# Dispose of command window

# Dispose of title graphic

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# * Frame Update
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
def update
# Update command window
@command_window.update
# If C button was pressed
if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
# Branch by command window cursor position
case @command_window.index
when 0  # New game

when 1  # Continue
command_continue
when 2  # Shutdown

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
The text box is the first line to be executed from what I can see:
Ruby:
#==============================================================================
# ** Main
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  After defining each class, actual processing begins here.
#==============================================================================

begin
  print($:.to_s + "u")
The Battler Fighter-01 graphic is drawn because of the code that comes right after:
Ruby:
for i in 0..10
    $sprites[i] = Sprite.new
    $sprites[i].bitmap = Bitmap.new("Graphics/Battlers/001-Fighter01.png")
    $sprites[i].zoom_x = $sprites[i].zoom_y  = 1.0 - ((i.to_f-6.0) / 5.0)
    $sprites[i].x = (i / 3) * 210
    $sprites[i].y = (i % 3) * 160
  end
And finally, this cycle prevents the following scripts from being started because it is an infinite loop:
Ruby:
while true
    Graphics.update
  end
Just create a new project and copy the Main script to replace this one. What I can conclude is that whoever did this was using RPGXP to test RGSS scripts without starting the game.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: $fontface = "Papyrus" and $fontsize = 18 can also be removed from Main script. Only illegal copies of RMXP needed them. The official release uses Font.default_name and Font.default_size instead.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
This is a method of some additional script that was disabled by the developer. Your friend probably did several tests on the project instead of creating a new blank project to test new scripts.
Unfortunately, most of these things can only be resolved by whoever is going to continue the project.
